answer: Edgar Allan Poe, the author of *“Annabel Lee,”* first enlisted in the U.S. Army on **May 26, 1827**. He joined the 3rd Regiment of Artillery—initially under the pseudonym “Edgar A. Perry”—and later served as Sergeant‑Major before his discharge in 1832.
